conventions.wires: wire 0 is the bottom wire (bit 0 of a state); the paper's wires 1,2,3,4 are 3,2,1,0
conventions.order: diagram order: the first letter of a word acts first
conventions.letters: ["X",t], ["CX",c,t], ["CCX",a,b,t] (controls a > b, then target), black controls
conventions.narrow: lin[i:j] (all letters on the triple) is replaced by new (a word on the triple with the same function)
conventions.rule7: perm p: CCX_{p3,p2->p1} CX_{p1->p0} CCX_{p3,p2->p1} = CCX_{p3,p2->p0} CX_{p1->p0}; fwd rewrites the left side at lin[i:i+3] into the right side, bwd the right side at lin[i:i+2] into the left side
conventions.lin: a linearisation of the current word (the same trace up to interchange of letters on disjoint wires); the next word is lin with the block replaced; the last word equals rhs up to interchange
